_about: Cards for the owner's saved contacts.

contacts.search.use_when: The person wants a saved contact's details, such as a phone number or email address.
examples: do I have an email for the plumber
look up grandma in my contacts
who do I have saved called anna
cuál es el teléfono de marta
was ist die Nummer von Jonas
not_for: what's the phone number for the police
how do I export my contacts

contacts.save.use_when: The person wants a new contact saved, or a number or address added to someone.
examples: add the plumber to my contacts, his email is joe@pipes.example
not_for: how do I add a contact on iphone

contacts.update.use_when: The person wants a saved contact changed: a new number, address, name or label.
examples: anna has a new phone number
not_for: how do I update my phone

contacts.delete.use_when: The person wants a saved contact removed.
examples: delete the old plumber from my contacts
not_for: how do I delete my facebook account
